english_policy.waiver_notes: International students from non-English speaking backgrounds must meet the minimum. Other accepted ways: Australian Year 12 with a passing grade in a recognised English as a Second Language or English Language subject; International Baccalaureate Diploma (including specific language subjects undertaken in English); foundation program at another Australian university; in limited circumstances previous academic qualifications or professional use of English (with certified documentation).

english.notes: IELTS Academic overall 6.5, each band 6. Same on the Computer Science, Economics and Mechanical Engineering degree pages.

Old 0-120 scale, from the page's equivalency table: overall 79 is the IELTS 6.5 column; the sub-scores are from the IELTS 6.0 column because the degrees require 6.0 in each IELTS band. No 1-6 scale score given.
From the equivalency table: overall 64 (IELTS 6.5 column); 60 per skill is the IELTS 6.0 column.
Cambridge C1 Advanced / C2 Proficiency: overall 176 (IELTS 6.5 column), 169 per skill (IELTS 6.0 column).
Not in the page's list of accepted tests (IELTS, PTE, TOEFL iBT, Cambridge C1/C2, OET for some degrees).

tier_notes.general: QS World University Rankings 2027: world rank 79, 8th of the Australian universities in the table (A = ranks 6-15 on the national scale; a national scale, so not comparable with US tiers).
